name: Gola-Tiwai Complex
description: In eastern Sierra Leone, the Gola-Tiwai Complex protects the country's largest tract of rainforest, along with Tiwai Island, a wildlife sanctuary set in a river. It is part of the Upper Guinean Forest, home to over 1,000 plant species, 55 mammals and up to 448 birds. Look for forest elephants, pygmy hippos and the rare white-necked rockfowl.
